sync_page_subtitle: Move playlists, history, likes and your taste profile between your devices — over your local network, end-to-end encrypted, no account needed.
sync_send_subtitle: Show a code for another device to scan.
sync_receive_subtitle: Scan or paste a code from another device.
sync_show_qr_button: No camera? Show a QR to scan
sync_show_qr_hint: This device shows a code; the other device scans it and sends its data here.
sync_collection_subscriptions_desc: The folders you sort your channels into
sync_pair_scan_subtitle: Open Flow on the other device and scan to receive your data.
sync_pair_receive_title: Show this to the other device
sync_pair_receive_subtitle: On the other device, scan this code and choose what to send here.
sync_verification_hint: Make sure both devices show the same code.
sync_host_address_hint: The other device must be able to reach this address. If it can't connect, check that both devices are on the same network and that a VPN or firewall isn't blocking it.
sync_camera_error: Could not start the camera. Paste the code manually instead, or check camera permissions.
sync_paste_is_sas: That's the verification code, not the sync code. Scan the QR with the camera, or paste the full sync data (it starts with "{").
sync_paste_invalid: This doesn't look like a sync code. Scan the QR with the camera instead.
sync_consent_merge_subtitle: Review what will be merged into this device.
sync_consent_allow_subtitle: This device will send the selected data to the connected device.
sync_verify_subtitle: Your other device will ask you to confirm this code before it accepts your data.
sync_waiting_accept: Waiting for the other device to accept…
sync_withheld_peer_newer: %s stayed on each device: the other device reads topics in a newer way. Update Flow Desktop to sync it.
sync_withheld_peer_older: %s stayed on each device: the other device reads topics in an older way. Update Flow there to sync it.
sync_withheld_key_language: %s stayed on each device: the two devices learned topics in different languages.
sync_up_to_date: Everything was already up to date.
sync_copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the text below and copy it yourself.
sync_copy_hint: No camera on the other device? Paste this into its "Enter connection data" box.
sync_not_connecting_hint: Not connecting? Check that both devices are on the same Wi-Fi. On Windows, set this network to Private and allow Flow through Windows Firewall.
sync_paste_is_address: That's a device address, not the sync code. Paste the full connection data (it starts with "{") or scan the QR code.
sync_error_expired: This code has expired. Make a new one on the other device. If codes keep expiring right away, check that the date and time are correct on both devices.
sync_error_invalid_code: That isn't a Flow sync code. Scan the QR code again or copy the full connection data.
sync_error_invalid_address: This code points outside your local network, so Flow won't connect to it. Only use codes shown by your own devices.
sync_error_no_peer: No device connected before the code expired. Check that both devices are on the same Wi-Fi and that a firewall isn't blocking Flow, then try again.
sync_error_busy: A sync is already running. Finish or cancel it first.
sync_error_not_default_profile: Switch to %1$s to sync. Other profiles stay on this computer only.
import_profiles_restored: Also restored %s other profiles. They open with their data the next time you switch to them.
import_old_master_into: This backup was made before profiles and is restored into %s. Continue?
profiles_menu_footer: Profiles keep feeds apart. They aren't locked.
profiles_footer: Each profile has its own recommendations, history, library and settings. Profiles keep feeds apart but aren't locked: anyone using this computer can switch. Downloads are shared.
profiles_photo_failed: Couldn't use that picture. Try a PNG, JPEG or WebP under 15 MB.
profiles_start_fresh_desc: Flow asks about your interests and learns from there.
profiles_copy_recommendations_desc: What Flow has learned, and the channels and topics you blocked
profiles_copy_note: History, likes, playlists and notes are never copied. Downloads are shared by every profile.
profiles_delete_body: Its recommendations, history, library and settings are removed from this computer. Downloads stay.
profiles_name_taken: A profile with this name already exists
profiles_switch_refused_sync: Finish syncing before you switch profiles
profiles_limit_reached: You can have up to %1$d profiles
profiles_delete_in_use: Switch to another profile before you delete this one. Default can't be deleted
profiles_copy_failed: Couldn't copy into the new profile. Nothing was created
sync_default_only_body: Other profiles stay on this computer only.
sync_error_unreachable: Couldn't reach the other device. Check that both devices are on the same Wi-Fi and that a VPN or firewall isn't blocking the connection.
sync_error_peer_closed: The other device closed the connection. Check it for a message, then try again.
sync_error_timeout: The other device stopped responding. Keep Flow open on both devices and try again.
sync_error_peer: The other device reported a problem: %s
sync_error_code_rejected: The other device didn't confirm the verification code, so nothing was sent.
sync_error_unsupported_version: The other device runs a version of Flow this one can't sync with. Update Flow on both devices.
sync_error_corrupted: The data was damaged on the way. Try again.
sync_error_apply_failed: The data arrived but couldn't be saved. Nothing on this device was changed.
sync_error_protocol: The two devices couldn't agree on the sync steps. Update Flow on both devices and try again.
linked_subtitle: Keep your devices in sync all the time through your own Flow server. Everything is end-to-end encrypted: the server stores data it can't read.
linked_setup_subtitle: Start a new group on a Flow server you host.
linked_admin_token_hint: The server prints it when it first starts. It's used once, to claim the server.
linked_join_subtitle: On a device that already syncs, open Linked devices and choose Link a device. Then scan its code or paste it here.
linked_restore_subtitle: Lost every device? Enter the server address and your 24 recovery words.
linked_words_subtitle: These 24 words restore your synced data if you lose every device. Write them down or keep the QR code somewhere safe. They're shown only this once.
linked_check_wrong: That doesn't match. Check the words you saved.
linked_recovery_unsaved: Your recovery key isn't confirmed. Without it you can't restore if you lose every device.
linked_remove_confirm: Remove %s? It stops syncing and can't read anything written after this.
linked_add_subtitle: In Flow on the other device, open Linked devices and scan this code. Both devices then show the same six digits.
linked_show_title: Scan this code with a linked device
linked_show_subtitle: On a device that already syncs, open Linked devices, choose Link a device, and scan or paste this code. Both devices need to be on the same network.
linked_scan_theirs: Or scan the other device's code
linked_confirm_subtitle: Check that the other device shows the same six digits.
linked_done_body: It syncs in the background from now on.
linked_removed_body: Another device removed this one from the group, so it no longer syncs.
linked_forget_confirm: Stop syncing on this device? Your data stays here. The group lists it until another device removes it.
linked_leave: Leave the group on this device
linked_leave_confirm: Leave the group on this device? It stops syncing and your data stays here. The other devices keep listing it until one of them removes it under Linked devices.
linked_error_insecure: The server must use HTTPS, unless it's on your local network.
linked_error_unreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Check the address and your connection.
linked_error_refused: The server refused the request. Check the address and the admin token.
linked_error_already_claimed: This server already has a group. Join it from a device that's already linked, or restore it with the recovery words.
linked_error_instance_changed: This isn't the server this device was linked to. It may have been reset.
linked_error_protocol: The server or the other device sent something invalid, so nothing was changed.
linked_error_local: Something went wrong on this device. Try again.
linked_error_not_linked: This device isn't in a sync group.
linked_error_removed: This device was removed from its sync group.
linked_error_declined: The codes weren't confirmed, so nothing was linked.
linked_error_timed_out: The other device didn't answer in time. Start again.
linked_error_wrong_words: These recovery words aren't valid. Check the spelling and the order.
linked_error_recovery_used: This recovery key was already used or replaced.
linked_error_already_linked: This device is already in a sync group.
linked_error_lan_unreachable: The other device couldn't be reached on this network. Connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi or LAN and try again.
player_error_age_restricted_hint: This video is only available to signed-in users who have verified their age, so it can't be played anonymously.
player_error_private_hint: The owner has set this video to private. Only people they've invited can watch it.
player_error_paid_hint: This video requires a purchase, rental, or channel membership on YouTube.
player_error_geo_hint: The content owner has restricted this video in your country. A VPN may let you watch it.
player_error_music_premium_hint: This track is only available to YouTube Music Premium subscribers.
player_error_bot_check_hint: YouTube is asking for verification before serving this stream. Try again in a moment, or open it in a browser and solve the check.
player_error_account_terminated_hint: This channel has been closed or terminated, so its videos can't be played.
player_error_not_available_hint: This video may have been deleted, made private, or removed by YouTube. Try again in case it's a temporary hiccup.
player_error_extractor_hint: Flow couldn't parse the playback data — YouTube may have changed its format. Try again, and update Flow if it keeps failing.
player_error_streaming_hint: The media stream couldn't be read. This is often a temporary YouTube issue — try again.
player_error_media_decode_hint: Flow tried another audio format and it failed too. Try again, or open the song in your browser.
player_error_stream_expired_hint: YouTube refused the link several times in a row. Try again in a moment.
player_error_members_only_hint: Only the channel's members can watch this video.
player_error_network_wall_hint: The bot check held even with a new identity. Try again later or from another network.
player_error_upcoming_hint: This premiere or live stream hasn't started. Flow will start it when it goes live.
player_error_rate_limited_title: YouTube asked Flow to slow down
player_error_rate_limited_hint: Too many requests went out in a short time. Wait a minute, then try again.
player_error_network_hint: Flow couldn't reach YouTube. Check your internet connection and try again.
player_error_validation_hint: This content couldn't be requested. If you reached it from a link, it may be malformed.
player_error_internal_hint: An unexpected error occurred inside Flow. Copy the logs so this can be diagnosed, then try again.
player_error_generic_hint: This content couldn't be played. Please try again.
player_codec_missing_hint: Audio is playing but your system can't decode the video. Flow needs the GStreamer video codecs, which aren't installed.
player_codec_missing_command_hint: On Debian/Ubuntu, install them and restart Flow:
settings_live_chat_desc: Show the chat panel on livestreams that have one
subtitles_track_unavailable: This subtitle track could not be loaded
subtitles_drag_hint: Drag subtitles on the video to move them for just that video.
settings_blocked_keywords_desc: Hide videos whose title or channel name matches one of these words
settings_blocked_mode_desc: Blur blocked videos with a reveal action, or leave them out of feeds entirely
settings_blocked_pin_desc: Ask for a PIN before a blocked video can be revealed. This is a lock against accident, not encryption — anyone with access to this computer's files can still read the block list.
persona_load_failed_body: The local recommendation engine didn't answer. Nothing was changed.
persona_load_empty_body: Your taste profile isn't ready yet.
persona_subtitle: Analyze and manage local recommendation signals, memory, and sync controls.
persona_taste_shape_desc: Global preference shape compared with the active time context, %s.
persona_interests_desc: Topic weights and the evidence signals used by the local recommendation model.
persona_evidence_empty: No topic evidence has been indexed yet.
persona_time_desc: Five time-based recommendation states summarized from weekly listening and viewing patterns.
persona_channels_desc: Channel affinity scores retained by the local recommendation model.
persona_channels_empty: No channel affinities have been logged yet.
persona_blocked_desc: Suppressed topics and creators excluded from recommendation ranking.
persona_activity_empty: No signals recorded yet. Watching, liking, and dismissing videos will appear here.
persona_data_desc: Backup, restore, or reset the local taste profile.
persona_reset_confirm_body: This permanently deletes pacing, topic, channel, and blocklist signals.
channel_home_empty: This channel has not set up its Home tab.
channel_tab_error: This tab could not be loaded.
channel_about_error: The About panel could not be loaded.
subscriptions_failed_title: Some channels could not be read
subscriptions_failed_body: Their newest uploads are missing from this feed: %s.
settings_video_loudness_desc: Turns down videos mastered louder than YouTube's target, so one video is not much louder than the next.
settings_content_language_desc: The language YouTube writes dates, view counts, labels and its translated titles in. Pages you open next follow it.
